title: City of Sydney — Dawes Point(Tar-Ra) Park current viewing conditions

facts.fact: Dawes Point offers partial fireworks views under the bridge on the southern side; there is no booking or registration requirement for this public site.
facts.excerpt: Offers partial fireworks views that become congested during the evening.
facts.location: Location introduction; Admission says no ticket, booking or registration required

facts.fact: Current conditions prohibit re-entry and alcohol; food may be bought or brought, and water/toilet facilities are listed.
facts.excerpt: You can buy food here or bring your own
facts.location: Food and beverages; restriction list includes no re-entry and no BYO alcohol

facts.fact: The 2025 time at which the venue reached capacity is historical evidence, not a predicted 2026 closing time.
facts.excerpt: This venue reached capacity at 7:30pm in 2025
facts.location: Admission, hours and capacity; the guide does not publish this as current deadline
